GPTBots.ai Bridges Chat-to-Execution Gap, Skan AI's ABCF Framework, IAB Tackles AI Bot Problem

GPTBots.ai bridges chat-to-execution gap. Skan AI introduces ABCF framework. IAB releases bot management guidance.

  1. 1

    GPTBots.ai: From Chat to Execution

    Aurora Mobile's enterprise AI platform has completed a major upgrade centered on knowledge base reconstruction, workflow execution, and enterprise governance. The key insight: Gartner predicts 40%+ of agentic AI projects will be canceled by 2027 — not because models aren't capable, but because AI can't plug into business systems. GPTBots is betting on knowledge graphs and hybrid retrieval to close the pilot-to-production gap.

    Skan AI Introduces ABCF Framework for Enterprise AI Agents

    The Agentic Business Context Foundation (ABCF) captures what traditional enterprise systems miss: human reasoning, exceptions, and workarounds. "A 1% gap in observational coverage compounds to roughly a 40% failure rate by execution." For PMMs, this signals the operational intelligence layer your AI agents need to actually work in production.

    IAB Tech Lab Tackles the Growing AI Bot Problem

    New guidance released today helps publishers and content owners decide who gets access to their content as AI crawlers proliferate. The framework complements the recently released CoMP API V1. For marketers: blanket bot blocking is no longer practical — the question is how to manage AI access strategically.

    Salesforce's Agentforce Reality Check

    Mercury News examines the gap between AI promise and reality at Salesforce. The argument: if agentic AI genuinely automates enterprise sales, service, and marketing operations, whoever owns the CRM data captures disproportionate value. But deployments remain early, and revenue impact is still materializing. Read this one: The GPTBots.ai piece on why 40% of agentic AI projects fail.
